tasks.description: audit-rounds.js: add classes note and deferred; classify, tally and decide take deferred ids and an optional index; tally returns notes and deferred counts; CLI passes deferred and index through classify, tally and decide. Tests in audit-rounds.test.js. Mirror to .claude/lib/. Depends on: none. Acceptance criteria: NEW behaviour (decide with PMI-T003 gap-unbuilt and deferred returns close:true, chain:false, reaudit:false; CLI classify returns deferred; requirement whose served_by is all deferred is deferred; tally notes:1 for fix-citation and consistency mismatch). REGRESSION guards: same input without deferred returns reaudit:true; mismatch on a deferred id is a defect; non-deferred gap-unbuilt under citation is a defect; covered:false stays uncovered-only; all 51 existing tests pass.

audit-build.js reconcile stage: accept args.deferred ([{id, why}]); widen FIXED THE CITATION from Could Not Verify to the whole TRD (descriptive text only) in the prompt opening and heading block; fixed items go back as action fix-citation; add heading PLANNED, NOT BUILT YET with deferred task id as handoff id; add deferred exception to the do-not-proceed MISSING IMPLEMENTATION rule; never edit objectives, criteria or tasks. Tests in audit-build.test.js. Mirror to .claude/workflows/. Depends on: none. Acceptance criteria: reconcile prompt carries each deferred id and why; no longer contains this step edits no other section nor restricts correction to Could Not Verify; requires fix-citation and deferred id as handoff id; do-not-proceed rule names the deferred exception; forbids edits to requirements.

/audit-build command: read parseTrd().deferred; pass list to workflow and ids plus index to tally, decide and per-item classify; record notes and deferred in round line; list notes and deferrals in STATE never ISSUES and never as a reason for NEXT /audit-build; reword step 3 other-item text; mirror heading block; add TRD path to audit commit git add and pathspec. Mirror to .claude/commands/. Depends on: FIX-001, FIX-002. Acceptance criteria: command passes deferred in workflow call and every classify, tally, decide example; record example carries notes and deferred; commit lines name the TRD; heading block matches workflow; verify-command-surface.test.js and runtime-integrity mirror parity pass.

Guard the audit's in-place TRD edits (amendment 2026-10-22): reconcile and index prompts find Could Not Verify only by a heading at line start, never a mid-line mention; audit-rounds.js gains trd-snapshot and trd-guard; /audit-build runs both around the workflow call and ends STUCK with TRD restored when the guard fails. Depends on: none stated. Acceptance criteria: trd-guard on a truncated TRD returns ok:false naming ### FIX-003 and ## Could Not Verify and the file is byte-identical to snapshot afterwards; citation-only edit returns ok:true and keeps the edit; a heading inside a fenced example is not counted; prompts no longer say headings CONTAINING or grep for bare ## Could Not Verify; mirror parity and the three suites pass. NOTE: this task has no ### AMEND-001 Task Grounding block, so no Touches list exists in the TRD.

requirements.statement: A gap on a task listed under ## Deferred by design is recorded as a note (planned, not built yet), never counted as a defect or test gap, never chained to a fix run, and never the reason for another audit round.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives table, row O1 (must pass: yes)

requirements.statement: A stale citation (wrong line number, path or id) or descriptive wording the code contradicts, anywhere in the TRD, is fixed in place in the same audit run and recorded as a note; never counted, chained or re-audited.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives table, row O2 (must pass: yes)

requirements.statement: Only a product defect (code missing or doing something other than required, on a task not deferred) opens another round; the round cap, the do-not-proceed rule and test-gap handling are otherwise unchanged.
requirements.source: TRD Objectives table, row O3 (must pass: not marked)

requirements.statement: Acceptance criteria for FIX-001: decide with PMI-T003 gap-unbuilt plus deferred returns close:true, chain:false, reaudit:false; CLI classify returns deferred; requirement with all-deferred served_by is deferred; tally reports notes:1 for fix-citation and consistency mismatch; regression guards pass (no-deferred input still reaudit:true; mismatch on deferred id stays a defect; non-deferred gap-unbuilt under citation stays a defect; covered:false uncovered-only; 51 existing tests pass).
requirements.source: TRD Master Task List, row FIX-001, Acceptance Criteria column

requirements.statement: Acceptance criteria for FIX-002: reconcile prompt carries each deferred id and why; no longer contains this step edits no other section nor restricts correction to Could Not Verify; requires fix-citation for in-place fixes and deferred id as handoff id; do-not-proceed rule names the deferred exception; forbids edits to requirements.
requirements.source: TRD Master Task List, row FIX-002, Acceptance Criteria column

requirements.statement: Acceptance criteria for FIX-003: command passes deferred in the workflow call and in every classify, tally and decide example; record example carries notes and deferred; commit lines name the TRD; heading block matches the workflow; verify-command-surface.test.js and runtime-integrity mirror parity pass.
requirements.source: TRD Master Task List, row FIX-003, Acceptance Criteria column

requirements.statement: Acceptance criteria for AMEND-001: trd-guard on a round-1-style truncation returns ok:false naming ### FIX-003 and ## Could Not Verify and restores the file byte-identical to snapshot; citation-only edit returns ok:true and keeps the edit; heading inside a fenced example is not counted; prompts no longer say headings CONTAINING or grep bare ## Could Not Verify; mirror parity and three suites pass.
requirements.source: TRD Master Task List, row AMEND-001, Acceptance Criteria column

requirements.statement: No edits by the audit to objectives, acceptance criteria or task requirements.

could_not_verify: No PRD exists for this change (decided in session, 2026-10-21); audit could not check objectives against product requirements, only that the code does what the TRD says. Whether O1-O3 capture the owner's intent fully is unchecked. (Source: Could Not Verify, bullet 1, line 124)

The pm-interface evidence behind O1 and O2 lives in another repository (forge-vnext: PMI-T003, PMI-P002); neither the evidence nor the reconstructed before-shape (rebuilt from round counts and report text, not a stored handoff) was checked. (Source: Could Not Verify, bullet 2, line 127)

In-place TRD edits are made by a model. Tests prove the prompt asks for them and forbids requirement edits, not that every run obeys. This audit is the first live instance; one run is not a rate. (Source: Could Not Verify, bullet 3, line 131)

Kind is declared change; reviewer noted O1 is closer to a defect (parser intent is that deferrals are reported, not discovered as failures). Classification for the owner, not a delivery claim; not checked. (Source: Could Not Verify, bullet 4, line 135)

The web-chat-parity six-stale-line-numbers loop did not reproduce: on 4.13.6 its round 2 closed with zero defects, citations carried as a caveat. Not re-run by this audit. (Source: Could Not Verify, bullet 5, line 138)

This audit's own rewrite truncated the TRD and was repaired by hand: the reconcile agent matched a quote of the section phrase inside FIX-002's grounding and replaced everything to end of file; restored from previous commit. Nothing in the workflow checks that an edit leaves other headings in place (addressed by AMEND-001). (Source: Could Not Verify, bullet 6, line 140)
open_questions: OQ-1: Should a deferred task's gap appear in the VERDICT's caveat list at all? Assumed: yes, once, as 'planned, not built yet: <task> — <the TRD's reason>', so a close still says what is outstanding. Owner-only: no. (Source: ## Open Questions, line 85)
